crossRefs.note: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

people.name: Ahuzzam
people.line: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite

people.name: Haahashtari
people.line: A descendant of Judah through Hezron.

people.name: Hepher
people.line: A son of Ashhur, from the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Naarah
people.line: Wife of Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.

people.name: Temeni
people.line: Son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') from the tribe of Judah

translations.web: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
translations.bsb: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
translations.kjv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
translations.asv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
